title: Compare JNR and Marpet ISO drafts; add blank record supplements
public_pr_body:
Compared the requested public ISO set against #371 Marpet and #372 JNR: both already have 28 core draft documents. #337 is a wipe-day runbook, not an ISO pack. Exact public source SHAs/paths/hashes are inventoried. No private/company records inspected and no Code-owned pack files changed.

Adds seven shared blank record forms, separate JNR/Marpet auditor retrieval sheets, and source-text Word copies missing for #360/#361/#363. Word text preserves the source lines/Markdown table syntax; print typesetting remains unverified. These are optional draft supplements, not newly approved QMS numbers or certification evidence. Every new record carries requirement, expected/actual, evidence, tester, date and approval fields; actual results are NOT EXECUTED and signatures blank.

Three offline document checks passed, zero failed/skipped; run metadata and log hash retained. Company adoption, operating records, real retrieval, effectiveness and certification readiness remain unproven. Marpet's actual Tolra use remains NOT VERIFIED. Management/adviser decisions cannot be filled in by Codex.

Docs/tests-only branch from main. No code, SQL, real data, private files, merges, #359/go-live changes or messages to John.
